title: High-Performance Solvent
description: &bHigh-Performance Solvent&r is a solvent which is used in an &3Ore Acidizer&r to further increase the products of bedrock ores, aswell as other recipes. It can be created from &bReformate Gas&r, from a &3Vacuum Refinery&r, and &bChlorine&r in an &3Industrial Mixer&r or be obtained from an &3RBMK&r Irradiation Channel.
To transport High-Performance Solvent by hand, a &6Hazardous Material Tank&r is needed.
&2High-Performance Solvent made from an RBMK irradiation channel requires an ore acidizer.
